reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Phase 03 claims the RPC path performs expensive KZG verification on invalid indices before filtering. Verified code behavior: RPC path (L247-249) does call KZG verification before the custody-based filter (L261). However, the underlying c-kzg-4844 library at crypto/kzg/src/lib.rs:L298-303 passes column_index directly to verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch. The c-kzg-4844 library has NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS (128) hardcoded per comment at L35-36. If index >= 128 is passed, c-kzg-4844 will reject it during verification, triggering InvalidColumn error and peer penalty (MidToleranceError) per block_lookups/mod.rs:L667-678. The filter at L261 is for custody-specific sampling columns, not index range validation - that validation happens inside the KZG library. Spec INV-001 requires index in [0, 128), and this is enforced by c-kzg-4844, not Lighthouse code. No exploitable DoS exists because invalid indices are rejected by the KZG library itself with peer penalty applied.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Spec fulu-p2p-interface SG-002 INV-001 requires sidecar.index < NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS. This is enforced by the underlying c-kzg-4844 library during KZG verification, not by explicit Lighthouse code.
